beats.title: pictures over music as the morning starts

beats.text: So what took you so long? *walking with Manic*
Dude, I had to make sure every one of my spikes are washed properly
Since when did you start worrying about your hygiene so much?
What do you mean?
ARE YOU WEARING PERFUME?!
Wow, you just noticed? Smells good, right?
Bro, girls wear perfume. Boys use spray
I already know that, I'm wearing it cause it's girls' favourite smell
Ah, I know what you're up to
Uhh... wha?
You're trying to impress Sal, aren't ya?
Uhh... uhm... maybe
No wonder why! Sweet little Manny
Alright, you got me... I'm trying to make Sally happy, but also I'm trying to earn fangirls too
What's the point getting fangirls when you have Sally!
Says the person who still has fangirls while being with Amy
Hey, it's not my fault that I'm attractive
and you say I'm not?
I never even said that
Hey! My girls!
OH MY GOODNESS! MANIIICC!!!
Hey ladies *wink*
I'm just gonna leave you with these girls, cya in a bit *walking away*
MAANNIICCC!
Settle down, there's plenty of Manny for all of-
AAAAHHH! SONIC!!! HELLLPPP!!
*chuckles* should've warned him about that *walking towards the school building*

beats.cap: *notices massive crowd outside the school building*

beats.text: Huh? What's going on?
Sonic! *running towards him* You're just on time!
Hey Tails! What's going on here? Why's everyone outside?
Look! *pointing at the banners above school about to be shown*

beats.cap: CHAOS HIGH BASKETBALL CHAMPIONSHIP OF MOBIUS *Banner now shows*

beats.text: *Everyone cheering*
WE'RE IN THE CHAMPIONSHIP?!
OH MY GOD! THAT'S AMAZING!
Please pinch me... I need to see if I'm dreaming...
But Sonic aren't you happy? It's actually happening!
HECK YEAH I AM! THIS IS THE FREAKING BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!!
SOMEONE PUNCH ME IN THE FACE RIGHT NOW!
Your welcome
YO KNUCKLES! YOU HEARD THE GREAT NEWS?!
HECK YEAH I DID!
WHAT ARE YOU ALL STARING AT? GET INSIDE AT ONCE! *walking through the crowd*
Great, Dr Eggman always have to ruin the excitement
Sonic! What've you got?
Sports with Vector, you?
Hey I have sports too! But with Maria *running into school with Sonic*
